title: Day 1/100 of Trading $10,000 on Robinhood Agentic
author: Newrateacc
selftext:
AI agents trading real money through Raijin on Robinhood, one post a day for 100 days, good and bad. 

Portfolio: $10,782.59 (10,323.79 on Robinhood excluding Coinbase and Kalshi) 

Yesterday (Sep 17): +$216.47 (+2.07%) across 26 live agents. No manual trades, every fill below is agent driven.

Biggest movers:

Business As Usual, $2,543.84, +$75.25 (+3.05%). Holds the S&P 500, flips into a 3x leveraged S&P 500 fund on days NY weather reads "normal for the season" off Kalshi's temperature markets. Yesterday was a normal weather day, so it was levered, that's most of today's dollar gain right there.

AI Picks & Shovels, $1,050.54, +$41.84 (+4.15%). Owns the AI buildout (chips, networking, power, memory), reweighted weekly on 60 day momentum.

FAANG+ Momentum, $2,422.52, +$22.78 (+0.95%). Rotates daily into the largest US tech names with positive 5 day momentum, sits in cash when none qualify.

The Silicon Overdrive, $92.26, +$5.80 (+6.71%), best percent day. Small experimental sleeve targeting 2x daily return of a US semiconductor index.

First of the Month, $1,008.09, +$12.53 (+1.26%). Sits in the S&P 500 all month, switches to 3x leveraged only across the turn of month window, last 4 plus first 3 sessions.

Pelosi Tracker, $521.61, +$17.61 (+3.49%). Mirrors Nancy Pelosi's disclosed buys, equal weighted over her trailing 30 days.

High Profile Congress, $498.53, +$7.61 (+1.55%) and Trump Tweet Trader, $350.20, +$5.96 (+1.73%). Same idea, different sources: congressional disclosures vs Trump's Truth Social posts read live and mapped to the companies he names.

FDA Inspector, $501.94, +$7.39 (+1.49%). Buys pharma names on FDA approval events, holds 30 days, up to 6 positions at once.

Only red name: WSB Consensus, down $0.02 (down 0.22%) on a $10 position. Spreads a token amount across whatever r/wallstreetbets is talking about most after the close. Basically flat, but it's the one I'd bet loses money over 100 days.

Everything else, Crypto Rotator, Dip Buyer, Founder Mode, Hot Hand, CT Scanner, The Print, The Harvester, The Contrarian, Trump Mention Trader, The Critic, Crypto Trend Following, The Sidestep, The Superfan, The Prognosis, NFL Fantasy Agent, Red and P 15, were all single digit dollar moves, up or down. Full list and thesis for each is in the app if anyone wants to dig in.

Day 1 tells you nothing on its own. The only thing I'm committing to is posting every day through day 100, including the days this looks embarrassing.

comments.author: QuanTradin
comments.body:
Business As Usual is the one I would watch hardest. levering into 3x on days Kalshi reads the weather as normal is a coin flip wearing a signal's coat, and on a green day it prints exactly what a real edge would print.

a hundred daily posts will not separate those two either. the levered days split out against the flat ones would.

replies.author: Newrateacc
replies.body: It comes from historical data on stocks performing better in normal weather

replies.author: QuanTradin
replies.body: Weather and stock returns is one of the oldest data-mined results going. Run enough weather variables against enough tickers and something always fits. I'd want to see it hold on a stretch of years you never looked at before it gets to size anything.

replies.author: Newrateacc
replies.body: You mean you’d want to wait for years before investing at all? Would miss out on a lot but gotcha

replies.author: QuanTradin
replies.body: Not years of sitting out, no. Paper and real can run side by side on the same signal, and that is what people skip. You keep the position, and the sample that tells you whether the weather effect survives out of sample builds alongside it rather than instead of it.

comments.author: Slight_Ad_6375
comments.body: Yeah it doesn’t tell much - what’s the AI role in this?

replies.author: Newrateacc
replies.body: AI is actually running these strategies and buying the stocks on my account. Like if Trump posts, AI will read it and decide to buy or not for me

replies.author: weluckyfew
replies.body: How do you access Trump posts, do you need to have a Truth Social account?

replies.author: Newrateacc
replies.body: Nah it’s through Raijin which I’m using. They watch the truth social feed and trade for me whenever he praises a stock

replies.author: weluckyfew
replies.body: What is Raijin?  My Google is only bringing up the Japanese god

replies.author: Newrateacc
replies.body: It’s Raijin.trade or Raijin on the App Store. It’s an AI or agentic trading app that is super simple to setup has been working extremely well for me so far. Highly recommend for anyone else who wants to check it out

replies.author: weluckyfew
replies.body: Thank you - don't think I'd want anything auto-trading for me (juist that little bit tech-phobic), but going to see if it can just give me the recommendations so I can trade it myself

replies.author: Newrateacc
replies.body: I think you can have it trade a small amount and manually size it up. But tbh a lot of the strats I like are momentum based so having it trade for me vs manually doing it saves me so much time and I don’t miss the jumps

comments.author: VisibleBee
comments.body: The headline P&L is only one layer. I would preserve the exact information and tool responses available at each decision, then compare the agent with a rules-only baseline including fills, fees, turnover, abstentions, concentration, and drawdown. That makes the result reproducible instead of just a live scorecard.
